fa.unbefristet: The alliance has no fixed expiry date; a later coalition breakdown remains possible.
fa.befristet: The party stays outside the coalition. If agreed today, it backs the government until {datum}.
fa.bleibt: {name} stays at {n} loyalty. The new alliance does not reset personal conflicts or talk cooldowns.
fa.neu: A new party leader starts with {n} loyalty.
fa.bruch: Already below {grenze}: another departure is possible at the review on {datum}. A new alliance alone does not stabilise this leader.
fa.stimmen: A seat majority does not guarantee every vote. Check the expected votes for the specific bill; supply bills also account for their clauses.
fa.pause: New negotiations are blocked during the recovery break until {datum}.
fa.sitze: All {n} faction seats will join the governing coalition.
fa.zielFest: This target is fixed when the agreement is signed. Later progress or new faction demands do not change the agreed obligation.
fa.zielBeschlossen: This target has already been adopted or reached. The new pledge can then be recorded as fulfilled without another bill.
